title: Crash with `numpy >=1.23.4` and `torch 1.13.0` due to `DLpack` interaction

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: python frontend
labels.description: For issues relating to PyTorch's Python frontend

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

We use PyTorch in our ML framework [Thinc](https://github.com/explosion/thinc), and we started noticing CI failures on both Windows and Linux after `torch 1.13.0` was released late last week. After isolating the delinquent test case, we were able to reproduce the crash locally with the following minimum reproducible example:

```python
import torch

x = torch.zeros(10)
data_np = x.detach().cpu().numpy()
rev = torch.utils.dlpack.from_dlpack(data_np)
x.data = rev
```
